description: List the account's audit events, newest first: access and configuration changes, approvals, API key use, and (at the full capture level) the agent's tool calls.

action.description: Only this action, e.g. connection.execute or approval.approve.

after.description: ISO-8601 time; only events at or after it.

ending_before.description: Return the page before this id — the first id from the previous page.

entity_type.description: Only events about this kind of record, e.g. integration_approval.

starting_after.description: Return the page after this id — the last id from the previous page.

name: list_audit_events

outputSchema.description: A page of audit events, newest first.
